_method: Read at each repository's default head (commit in data/<repo>/prs.json default_head) with `statusquo_scan.sh <clone> <default ref>`: .github/workflows/*.yml, nx.json, turbo.json, every package.json, vitest/jest configs, .circleci, lefthook/husky; grep for Nx/Turbo affected or remote cache, --changed, --changedSince, related, --findRelatedTests, --onlyChanged, Datadog TIA, Launchable, Develocity, CircleCI test selection; then the test step of each workflow read by hand. No nx.json, turbo.json or .circleci exists in any of the 9 repositories.

codex-multi-auth.ci_test_command: .github/workflows/ci.yml:55 npm run coverage -> package.json:106 npm run build && vitest run --coverage --maxWorkers=1 (full suite on every PR; also ci.yml:45 one-file lockfile guard)
